text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 192 May 14, 1973
GRANTING PHILIPPINE CITIZENSHIP TO RONALD FREDRICK WILLIAM NATHANIELSZ
WHEREAS, Ronald Fredrick Willian Nathanielsz, a citizen of Ceylon, has, by his long and continuous
service to the Filipino people, in the field of journalism proven himself worthy of all the rights, privileges and
prerogatives of a citizen of this country; and
WHEREAS, since his arrival in 1962 he and his family has decided to make this country their permanent
home to which they shall forever owe and pledge their allegiance and loyalty;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of the Philippines and
pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081 dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1 dated September 22,
1972, do hereby grant Philippine citizenship to Ronald Fredrick William Nathanielsz with all the rights,
privileges and prerogatives appurtenant thereto.
This Decree is made part of the law of the land and shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
